deep_dive.title: A Visible-Frequency Excitonic Reststrahlen Band in (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ Slabs
deep_dive.abstract: Layered halide perovskites host exceptionally strong excitons, whose optical signatures are usually interpreted as absorptive resonances on a smooth dielectric background. Strong excitons, however, can also reshape the dielectric response itself and drive the real permittivity negative, opening a reflective band: the visible, excitonic analogue of an infrared Reststrahlen band. Whether bare (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ slabs reach this regime has remained unclear. Here we show that low-temperature transmission of (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ slabs, driven by the intralayer-exciton manifold, evolves with increasing thickness from an excitonic dip into a broad near-zero-transmission interval with compressed Fabry-Pérot-like fringes. Transfer-matrix analysis with an effective Lorentz-oscillator dielectric response reproduces this crossover, reconstructs a finite negative-Re($\varepsilon$) window, and implies near-ultrastrong exciton-photon coupling. Calculated field maps show suppressed in-plane field penetration within this interval and a driven longitudinal response near the high-energy ($\varepsilon=0$) edge. These results identify (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ slabs as a cavity-free visible-frequency excitonic Reststrahlen material.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: The paper demonstrates that strong excitons in layered perovskite (PEA)2PbI4 slabs can lead to negative real permittivity and a visible-frequency excitonic Reststrahlen band, with near-zero transmission emerging from thickness-dependent Fabry-Pérot-like fringes, revealing an epsilon-near-zero regime.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 该论文解决了层状钙钛矿(PEA)2PbI4中强激子能否使介电常数反转的问题。通过变温透射光谱和转移矩阵方法，作者展示了随着厚度增加，透射谱从激子吸收谷演变为宽近零透射区间，并伴随压缩的Fabry-Pérot条纹。这表明强激子重塑了光学响应，在激子共振附近实现了介电常数从正到负的过渡，即epsilon近零状态。该工作揭示了可见光波段的激子Reststrahlen带，为可见光零折射率材料和激子-极化激元研究提供了新平台。
